I am hunting DEAD or LYING UI. Definition:
- A control (button/toggle/form/select) that calls nothing, or calls an action nobody consumes.
- A preference persisted to the DB where NO code anywhere reads that column to change behaviour. Investigate SPECIFICALLY and trace end-to-end: User.notificationPrefs (does ANY email/notification send path consult lib/prefs.ts normalizePrefs before sending? or is it write-only?), ApiToken.scopes and ApiToken.expiresAt and ApiToken.revoked (are they enforced in lib/api-auth.ts and every /api/v1 route?), Membership.areas (is memberCanAccess actually called by any dashboard page/layout?), User.backupCodes, User.sessionVersion.
- Status text/badges that cannot reflect reality (hardcoded, or from a field never updated).
- Success toasts shown unconditionally even when the underlying call failed.
- Progress bars / "in progress" states that never advance or complete (check ClaudeBuild.status transitions against what the worker actually sets).
- Forms submitting to an action that returns success but silently no-ops.
- Links/buttons navigating to routes that 404 or tabs that don't exist.

Two known examples that calibrate the bar but must NOT be re-reported: (1) User.autoRechargeEnabled written by lib/actions-billing-prefs.ts but nothing calls that action and no worker reads the columns. (2) A migration action computed an honest outcome and the caller hardcoded status:"DONE".

VERIFY every finding by reading the code. Give ABSOLUTE file:line and a CONCRETE failure scenario. Drop anything you cannot make concrete. Depth beats breadth, do not pad.

Return findings directly as your final message. Do NOT write any file. Also state which parts you checked and found SOLID.

content.text:
I've traced every item end-to-end. Here are the verified findings.

## Confirmed dead / lying UI

### 1. `User.notificationPrefs` is write-only — the entire Notifications card controls nothing

**Files:** `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/NotificationPrefs.tsx:7-42`, `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-prefs.ts:14-21`, `/opt/nxeon/lib/prefs.ts:20`

Full trace of every reader of the column:
- `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/settings/page.tsx:48` — `normalizePrefs(user.notificationPrefs)`, used only to set `defaultChecked` on the toggles it just rendered.
- `/opt/nxeon/app/api/account/export/route.ts:127` — dumps it into the GDPR export.

That is *all*. `normalizePrefs` has exactly two call sites and neither is a send path. `/opt/nxeon/lib/mailer.ts:118` `sendMail()` takes `to`/`userId` and never loads the user or consults prefs; neither do its four callers (`actions-account.ts:130,172`, `actions.ts:136`, `actions-newsletter-campaign.ts`, `stripe.ts`). All ~35 `db.notification.create` sites (worker/*, `lib/actions-support.ts:33,63,72`, `lib/actions-feedback.ts:53,98`, `worker/billing.ts`, …) write unconditionally. There is no `unsubscribe`/preference check anywhere in `lib/mailer.ts` or `lib/email-render.ts`.

Two of the three toggles are worse than inert:
- **"Product updates"** — campaigns are sent to `db.newsletterSubscriber` by email address (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-newsletter-campaign.ts:193`), a table populated by the public signup form and completely unlinked from `User`. Turning the toggle off cannot stop a single campaign.
- **"Security alerts — New sign-ins and changes to tokens or 2FA"** — no such alert exists at all. `login` (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions.ts:141-179`) writes only an audit row; `createApiToken`/`revokeApiToken` (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-tokens.ts:54,66`) and all of `actions-2fa.ts` write only audit rows. The toggle governs a channel that was never built.

**Failure scenario:** A customer turns all three toggles off, sees "Saved ✓" (`NotificationPrefs.tsx:40`), reloads and sees them persisted off — then keeps receiving every invoice, deploy, renewal-dunning and marketing email exactly as before.

---

### 2. `Membership.areas` / `memberCanAccess` are never enforced — the whole per-member access editor is decorative

**Files:** `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/MemberAreas.tsx:47-79`, `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-teams.ts:195-232`, `/opt/nxeon/lib/team-guard.ts:16-25`, `/opt/nxeon/lib/team-areas.ts:71-106`

`requireArea(orgId, area)` in `/opt/nxeon/lib/team-guard.ts:16` has **zero call sites**. (The 60+ `requireArea` hits in the repo are all the unrelated staff-RBAC `lib/rbac.ts:99` used by `/app/admin/**`.) `memberCanAccess` is called only from `team-guard.ts:23` (dead) and from `memberCanAccessHref` (`team-areas.ts:105`), which is itself called from nowhere. `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/layout.tsx:98-106` filters the nav on feature flags only — it never loads a Membership. The module's own ORCHESTRATOR NOTE (`team-areas.ts:108-133`) admits the wiring was never done.

`Membership` is read in only three places repo-wide: the Team page itself, the GDPR export (`/opt/nxeon/app/api/account/export/route.ts:103`) and the GDPR count (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-gdpr.ts:42`). No dashboard page, layout, or server action for servers/billing/domains/invoices consults it.

**Failure scenario:** An owner adds a contractor as `MEMBER`, unchecks everything except "Support", and the UI replies **"Access updated."** (`MemberAreas.tsx:34`). The contractor signs in and sees their own, unchanged dashboard — the membership grants them nothing and restricts them from nothing. The Team page's promise, *"invite teammates to collaborate on a shared account"* (`/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/team/page.tsx:59`), is contradicted only by a code comment (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-teams.ts:16-18`: shared billing and shared server access are "OUT OF SCOPE").

Latent contradiction inside the same feature: `setMemberAreas` documents an empty list as *"no restricted areas"* (`actions-teams.ts:192`) but `memberCanAccess` (`team-areas.ts:75-76`) returns `false` for every key when `areas === []` — i.e. unchecking every box would lock the member out of everything, the opposite of the stated semantics. Inert today, a trap the moment enforcement is wired.

---

### 3. A build that reaches `AWAITING_APPROVAL` becomes permanently unapprovable after a page reload — and then blocks the server forever

**Files:** `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/ClaudeBuilder.tsx:37,43-66,230-260`, `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/build/page.tsx:68,71-103`, `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-claude.ts:69-87,113-120`

The Approve/Reject buttons only render inside `ClaudeBuilder`, gated on `status === "AWAITING_APPROVAL"` where `status` comes from polling `/api/claude/{buildId}` — and `buildId` lives purely in React state (`ClaudeBuilder.tsx:37`, `setBuildId` only at line 90 right after `submitBuild`). `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/build/page.tsx:68` mounts `<ClaudeBuilder servers={servers} />` with **no build prop**, so there is no resume path. The "Recent builds" table (lines 86-98) renders prompt/server/status/steps/when — no row id, no link, no approve control.

`approveBuild`/`rejectBuild` are the only transitions out of `AWAITING_APPROVAL` (`actions-claude.ts:118,150`); the worker never re-touches that state (`/opt/nxeon/worker/claude.ts:239` returns early unless `QUEUED`/`PLANNING`), no job is left pending, and there is no reaper anywhere (`AWAITING_APPROVAL` appears in only 5 non-comment places repo-wide) and no admin screen touches `claudeBuild`.

**Failure scenario:** Submit a build; planning takes up to 90 s (`worker/claude.ts:249`), so the user switches tabs or hits F5. The worker sets `AWAITING_APPROVAL`. On return, the page shows a bare form plus a "Recent builds" row that can never be acted on. `submitBuild` now refuses every retry on that host — `serverBusy > 0` → *"A build is already in progress on this server."* (`actions-claude.ts:82-87`) — and after three such orphans, `MAX_ACTIVE_BUILDS_PER_USER` (`actions-claude.ts:22,69-74`) refuses **all** builds on **all** servers, permanently, with no customer-reachable escape.

Compounding it: `AWAITING_APPROVAL` and `PLANNING` have no entry in `statusColors` (`/opt/nxeon/components/ui/primitives.tsx:71-99`), so `StatusDot` falls back to `STOPPED` — neutral grey, no pulse. The one status that *requires* the customer to act renders in exactly the "nothing to see here" styling that the comment at `primitives.tsx:83-87` was written to prevent.

---

### 4. The API-token "write" scope grants access to nothing, and can produce a token that is dead on arrival

**Files:** `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/SecuritySettings.tsx:205-213`, `/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-tokens.ts:16,27-31`, `/opt/nxeon/lib/api-auth.ts:79-88`, `/opt/nxeon/app/api/v1/servers/route.ts:20`

`find app/api/v1 -name route.ts` returns exactly one file, exporting only `GET`, requiring `servers:read`. `authenticateApiToken`/`tokenHasScope` have no other call sites in the codebase. So no route consumes `write` — the checkbox mints a permission for an endpoint set that doesn't exist.

Worse, the two scope vocabularies don't match: the UI mints `["read"]`/`["write"]`, the route asks for `"servers:read"`. `tokenHasScope` (`api-auth.ts:86`) rescues `read` via the `action === "read"` special case, but `["write"]` matches none of the four branches.

**Failure scenario:** A user building a deploy integration unchecks "read", checks "write", and gets a token the Settings list badges as active with scope **`write`** (`SecuritySettings.tsx:255`). Every call it can make — the single live endpoint — returns `403 Token missing required scope: servers:read`. The token is inert and nothing in the portal says so. (The marketing docs at `/opt/nxeon/app/(marketing)/docs/page.tsx:102-106` correctly list write endpoints under "coming next"; only the portal control lies.)

---

### 5. "N active" tokens counts expired tokens the same list flags as expired

**File:** `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/SecuritySettings.tsx:301-303` vs `:250-256`

Header: `tokens.filter((t) => !t.revoked).length`. Row badge: `t.expiresAt && t.expiresAt < new Date()` → `expired`. `authenticateApiToken` rejects it with 401 (`/opt/nxeon/lib/api-auth.ts:53-55`).

**Failure scenario:** A user with one 30-day token comes back on day 31. The card header reads **"1 active"**, the row underneath reads **"expired"**, and the API 401s. The count is the number the user scans first when auditing credentials.

---

### 6. `/dashboard/projects` becomes unreachable as soon as it has been used once

**Files:** `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/layout.tsx:16-59`, `/opt/nxeon/components/customer/ProjectAssign.tsx:19-29`, `/opt/nxeon/components/portal/Shell.tsx:255,271`

Repo-wide, `/dashboard/projects` is referenced by exactly three lines: two `revalidatePath` calls (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-account.ts:75,82`) and one `<Link>` at `ProjectAssign.tsx:23` — which renders **only** inside the `projects.length === 0` early-return. The dashboard `nav` array has no Projects entry, and the command palette is fed from that same array (`Shell.tsx:255` → `271`), so ⌘K can't find it either. `Shell.tsx` has exactly one hardcoded dashboard link (`/dashboard/refer`, line 423).

**Failure scenario:** User follows the "Create one" link, creates "Production", and is redirected back. That link is now permanently gone from the UI. There is no nav item, no palette entry, no breadcrumb — the only route to their project list (and the only Delete-project control, `ProjectForms.tsx:49-58`) is typing the URL by hand.

---

## Secondary (verified, lower impact)

- **`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-claude.ts:169` `listBuilds`** — exported server action with zero call sites repo-wide.
- **`/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/page.tsx:174`** — the Access column renders `${PUBLIC_IP}:${sshPort}`, but the worker sets `sshPort = null` for dedicated-IP servers (`/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:242`, and `:479` on later IP assignment). A customer who paid for the dedicated-IPv4 add-on sees **"—"** under Access on the dashboard home, even though the server *is* reachable at `root@<dedicatedIp>` — which the detail page renders correctly (`/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/servers/[id]/page.tsx:129-130`). Same defect at `/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/servers/page.tsx:32`.
- **`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-onboarding.ts:29,33`** — the "Add funds to your wallet" step is `done` if any positive `walletTransaction` exists *or* `balanceCents > 0`. When `signup_free_credit_cents > 0` (`/opt/nxeon/lib/settings.ts:65` defaults it to `"0"`, so config-dependent), `grantSignupCredit` (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-growth.ts:238-246`) writes a "Welcome credit" row during registration, so a brand-new user's checklist opens at 25% with that step already struck through and badged **Done** before they have done anything. Same for an admin courtesy credit (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-admin-billing.ts:161`).

---

## Checked and SOLID

- **`User.sessionVersion`** — minted into the JWT as `sv` (`/opt/nxeon/lib/auth.ts:15-18`), compared on every resolve with old-token-as-0 handling (`:81-84`), incremented by `changePassword` (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-account.ts:37-39`, which then re-issues for the acting session) and `resetPassword` (`:148-151`). Genuinely evicts sessions.
- **`User.backupCodes`** — hashed at generation, consumed once and removed by `verifyTotpForUser` (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-2fa.ts:59-65`), which the login flow really calls (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions.ts:167-172`) and `disableTotp` accepts (`:149`); cleared on disable (`:157`).
- **`ApiToken.revoked` / `expiresAt` / `lastUsedAt`** — all three enforced/stamped in `/opt/nxeon/lib/api-auth.ts:52-63`; the "used X ago / never used" text is real.
- **2FA enrolment guards** — refusal while impersonating and refusal to clobber an active secret (`actions-2fa.ts:80-89`) are surfaced by the UI rather than swallowed (`/opt/nxeon/components/customer/SecuritySettings.tsx:126-128`).
- **SSH keys** — the "injected into new servers automatically at deploy time" copy is true: `worker/index.ts:280-283` reads `db.sshKey` and passes `cfg.sshkeys` to Proxmox (`:289`).
- **Support** — create/reply/close/reopen all persist; `Ticket.priority` chosen by the customer is really consumed by admin sort and badge (`/opt/nxeon/app/admin/support/page.tsx:43,97`); the nav's Support badge derives from live `OPEN`/`CUSTOMER_REPLY` counts (`/opt/nxeon/app/dashboard/layout.tsx:116-125`); the CLOSED branch correctly swaps the reply form for the reopen hint.
- **Feedback** — `submitFeedback` persists and notifies staff; `status`/`adminNote` are written by the admin action and rendered back to the reporter, with a notification on status change (`/opt/nxeon/lib/actions-feedback.ts:97-105`). Every status in `statusTone` is reachable.
- **Claude build pipeline (mechanics)** — `CLAUDE_BUILD` *is* registered (`/opt/nxeon/worker/index.ts:11,781`); every status the client renders is really written by the worker (`PLANNING` :241, `AWAITING_APPROVAL` :264, `RUNNING` :293, `DONE`/`FAILED` :333) and `steps`/`log` stream incrementally via `append` (:297-300) into the polled endpoint. The "nothing runs until you approve" claim holds — `executePhase` only runs on `approved=true` and re-checks the denylist per command (`:312`).
- **BYOK key** — `connectAnthropicKey` validates shape, AES-GCM encrypts (`/opt/nxeon/lib/crypto-box.ts:22-28`), never returns the key; the Connected/Not connected badge is derived from `anthropicKeyEnc` on each render.
- **TerminalDock** — provider genuinely mounted at `/opt/nxeon/components/portal/Shell.tsx:269`; every control (tab focus/close, `+` picker via `listTerminalServers`, minimize/restore, close-all, Reconnect) is wired to real behaviour, and the status dot/error strip reflect actual socket state.
- **Onboarding checklist** — all four `done` flags are computed from live queries; dismissal is persisted both client-side and via the server action; the card self-hides at 100%.
- **Activity** — real `auditLog` rows, no hardcoded entries; `humanizeAction` degrades gracefully on unknown scopes.
- **Claude Code "Already installed"** — actually true: `worker/index.ts:105-115` bakes `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code` into cloud-init for every server, and the hub discloses the manual install line for pre-feature servers (`ClaudeCodeHub.tsx:367-375`).
